Descending:
ordered_multiset<int, greater<int>> s = {2, 9, 4, 9};

cout << s[0] << '\n';                               // 9
cout << s.order_of_key(4) << '\n';                  // 2: values before 4 are 9, 9
cout << *s.lower_bound(5) << '\n';                  // 4
cout << s.count_range(9, 3) << '\n';                // 3: 9, 9, 4
cout << s.count_range(3, 9) << '\n';                // 0: reversed in this ordering
